digest.component_or_area: tracker initialization and environment identity management
propositions: Re-cloning a tracker without carrying over .env-id, .opcert-key, and .opcert-key.pub silently regenerates a new environment identity and orphans all prior op-cert attestations signed under the old identity.
Minting a fresh .env-id into a store already containing events from a different environment must warn loudly with an explicit override, never silently complete the re-identification.

The rebar fsck command must detect and report ENV_ID_MISMATCH when the current environment's author also wrote events under a different environment identity, surfacing re-clone incidents store-wide rather than at a later gate.
Legitimate multi-clone topologies with multiple environment identities from different authors must not trigger the ENV_ID_MISMATCH check (scoped by author rather than all identities).
A genesis store with no prior events must mint .env-id with no warning; REBAR_ALLOW_ENV_REIDENTIFY=1 allows deliberate re-identification while still warning.
